Broccoli & cheddar pasta

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

A simple milk-and-cheese sauce coats pasta and tender broccoli.

North American · dinner, pasta · easy

Servings: 2

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 20 min

Total: 30 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 5 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: Milk, Wheat. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 6 ounces dry egg-free wheat pasta (170 g Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups broccoli florets
  • 3/4 cup pasteurized milk (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 3/4 cup microbial-rennet cheddar cheese (Grated. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 tablespoon all-purpose wheat flour (Do not taste raw flour or uncooked batter. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 tablespoon butter (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 8 cups water (1.9 L, for boiling)
  • 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper

Cooking instructions

  1. Boil the water and cook the dry egg-free wheat pasta for its package time, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
  2. Melt the butter in a saucepan on medium-low. Stir in the all-purpose wheat flour and cook for 1 minute without browning.
  3. Whisk in the pasteurized milk gradually and simmer for 3–4 minutes until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in the microbial-rennet cheddar cheese and ground black pepper until melted.
  4. Fold the drained pasta and broccoli into the sauce and serve immediately.
